notes: VERBATIM copy of SN74AHCT125.cir, the only file in SCLM256.ZIP (Rev 2.0, 2019-11-14, 'generated from datasheet values', typical at 25 C, written for TINA-TI). Used for U-LVL-MOD in hardware/module/digital-and-supervision/sim. Runs in ngspice 42 with ngbehavior=psa once a deck defines the global parameter maxICC that its input subcircuit reads and never defines (.PARAM MAXICC = maxICC). Output resistance tables: R_OH 70 ohm and R_OL 46 ohm at VCC 4.5 V. It has a ground clamp on the output but no clamp to VCC, which the datasheet's I_OK (VO > VCC) row says the part has.
